question: What was the ratio of Booking Holdings, formerly known as The Priceline Group Inc., to the NASDAQ Composite Index at the measurement point of December 31, 2016?
retrieval_query: Booking Holdings formerly known as The Priceline Group Inc. NASDAQ Composite Index December 31 2016 ratio
answer:
The ratio of The Priceline Group Inc. to the NASDAQ Composite Index at December 31, 2016, is 313.45 / 216.54 = 1.447.
